executionRulings: Ruling: Use origin/main 5879517d rather than old design branch — preserves #249 bootstrap and #251 offline handling — baseline changes must be measured on this newer source.
Ruling: Use manual detached worktree in .worktree because native API cannot select the user's required directory — isolated checkout stays in writable project — cost: not app-managed cleanup.
Ruling: Creating an external issue was rejected by auto-review; detached implementation continues while explicit authorization is pending — no issue/branch publication.
Ruling: Cold browser measurements run from an installed Playwright library to control new contexts and CDP per visit — CLI wrapper stalled resolving npm — no product dependency added.
Ruling: Task 1 browser collection overlapped independent foundation edits only after freezing the baseline production build — measured source remains 5879517d.

Ruling: Preserve new SessionBootstrap only for a session detected before initial route render; inserting it after modal activation would remount start — keep its original restore/redirect behavior for saved sessions.

Task 5: Ruling: Production uses the _Board fork and BoardCopyBundle/BoardSlots, not UI Table — put the rules slot on that existing production interface and retain the old copy fallback; leave playground UI Table unchanged — cost: the production and kit slot APIs differ intentionally.

Task 6: Ruling: Board preloading belongs to app SessionActivation rather than a page importing app upward — preload only for an established in-lobby session — avoids downloading board for an unopened invitation.

Task 8: Ruling: Chromium 148 caches a failed native JS-module fetch; a reset importer made zero new requests (observed attempts=1). Known JS/CSS module failures now offer explicit refresh rather than a nonfunctional Retry; JSON failures retain real retry. No automatic reload; the session survives until user chooses refresh. Cost: a transient native module failure requires explicit session reconnect. New DeferredContent regression test failed then passed for this policy.

Task 4/6: Ruling: Commit session ownership and route composition together because main.tsx shares the injected store/router constructor — the intermediate main import must not reference uncommitted route files — separate tests still validate each deliverable.
Task 7: Ruling: Put vendorChunks.ts under config/ instead of build/ because the repository ignores build directories — keeps source tracked normally.

Task 7: Ruling: First hash experiment invalidated almost all app chunks via shared exports in entry. Add explicit start-screen and session-context chunks so async features do not import bootstrap. This follows cache-isolation acceptance; cost: two more initial requests, measured again.

Final: Ruling: Timing acceptance remains implementer-owned — five final cold visits per URL improve FCP/LCP under the baseline protocol; reviewer did not rerun them — cost if wrong: local timing gains may not reproduce on target devices.

Final: Ruling: Hosted cache acceptance stays unverified — final SHA-256 experiment proves unchanged URLs/content for 47 other JS/CSS files; no authorized deployment — cost if wrong: hosting policy may still force repeat downloads.

Final: Ruling: Transport/lifecycle acceptance uses the implementer browser evidence — same open DataChannel token/id across routes and next match; refreshed host/guest restore after saved checkpoint — cost if wrong: remote TURN/mobile lifecycle differences remain untested.

Final: Ruling: Full-suite acceptance uses fresh implementer output after review fix — 2907 tests, typechecks, lint, frontend and playground builds pass; reviewer did not rerun — cost if wrong: platform-specific issues may remain.
